# mhng-plugins

Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace maintained by **milehighnomadgrouptech**.

A curated set of skills, commands, and agents bundled as Claude Code plugins. Install the marketplace once, then install (and later update) any plugin inside it through Claude Code's built-in `/plugin` system.

> Make sure you trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it. Plugins can run code, call external services, and modify files.

**For AI agents:** read [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) before adding or modifying anything here.
**Looking for a specific skill?** See [INDEX.md](./INDEX.md) for the full map.

## Structure

```
mhng-plugins/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── marketplace.json      # registers every plugin
├── plugins/                  # internally-authored plugins live here
│   └── mhng-repo-mind/
│       ├── .claude-plugin/plugin.json
│       ├── skills/
│       ├── README.md
│       └── LICENSE
├── external_plugins/         # reserved for third-party plugins (empty)
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

Each plugin follows the standard Claude Code layout:

```
plugin-name/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── plugin.json      # plugin metadata (required)
├── .mcp.json            # MCP server config (optional)
├── commands/            # slash commands (optional)
├── agents/              # agent definitions (optional)
├── skills/              # skill definitions (optional)
├── hooks/               # hook definitions (optional)
└── README.md
```

## Install the marketplace

In Claude Code, run:

```
/plugin marketplace add milehighnomadgrouptech/mhng-plugins
```

## Install a plugin

```
/plugin install mhng-repo-mind@mhng-plugins
```

Or browse interactively:

```
/plugin
```

## Update plugins

Pull the latest versions of installed plugins:

```
/plugin update
```

## Available plugins

| Plugin | Description | Version |
|---|---|---|
| [`mhng-repo-mind`](./plugins/mhng-repo-mind) | Forensic per-file analyses, dbt-style dependency graph, cross-file contract audits, compliance reports, and branch-parity docs for any codebase. | 1.8.0 |

## Adding a new plugin

> AI agents: follow the full workflow in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md). The summary below is for human maintainers.

1. Create the plugin directory:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p plugins/<plugin-name>/.claude-plugin
   ```
2. Add `plugins/<plugin-name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`:
   ```json
   {
     "name": "<plugin-name>",
     "version": "0.1.0",
     "description": "<what it does>",
     "author": { "name": "milehighnomadgrouptech" },
     "homepage": "https://github.com/milehighnomadgrouptech/mhng-plugins/tree/main/plugins/<plugin-name>",
     "repository": "https://github.com/milehighnomadgrouptech/mhng-plugins",
     "license": "MIT",
     "keywords": []
   }
   ```
3. Add any of: `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, `commands/*.md`, `agents/*.md`, `hooks/*.json`, `.mcp.json`.
4. Register the plugin in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` by appending to the `plugins` array:
   ```json
   {
     "name": "<plugin-name>",
     "source": "./plugins/<plugin-name>",
     "description": "<what it does>",
     "version": "0.1.0",
     "category": "<category>",
     "tags": ["<tag1>", "<tag2>"]
   }
   ```
5. Update [INDEX.md](./INDEX.md) with the new skill's entry.
6. Commit. The maintainer pushes to GitHub. Users receive it on next `/plugin update` (or fresh install).

## Updating a plugin

1. Edit files in `plugins/<plugin-name>/`.
2. Bump `version` in **both**:
   - `plugins/<plugin-name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
   - the matching entry in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
3. Update `plugins/<plugin-name>/CHANGELOG.md` if the plugin has one.
4. Update [INDEX.md](./INDEX.md) to match the new version.
5. Commit. The maintainer pushes.
6. Users run `/plugin update` to pick up the new version.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). Individual plugins may ship their own license; see each plugin's directory.

## Docs

- [Claude Code plugins documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins)
